subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
Which of the following is true ? 
 
(a) K-map has more than one solution. 
 
(b) K-map has always unique solution. 
 
(c) K-map can have more than one solution. 
 
(d) None of these

options.text: K-map has more than one solution.
K-map can have more than one solution.

explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-04 (Standard Combinational Circuits).
